publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.1.1 fixes a local development server file exposure in 0.1.0. Requests reaching rer dev through a proxy could read the checkout dev key and data/local-secrets.json, exposing local session, setup and runner secrets. Vite now serves only application source, public assets and dependencies, and blocks private rer/installer files and exports. The updated Base proxy also blocks Local Explorer, scheduled debug handlers and exported archives, and rejects archive export locations that the development server would serve. Setup and preview keep these private files unavailable. Dev sign-in still requires the checkout key. Users should update, run rer reset --yes after exporting any data they need to preserve, and rer setup again to rotate local secrets and invalidate earlier dev access. This patch does not establish hosted operation or recipient acceptance.
